rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose term for cereal crops and their harvested grain.

example.jyutping: ni1 go3 nung4 coeng4 zyu2 jiu3 zung3 guk1 mat6

rows.note: Use this construction for one individual seed or one small granular particle, such as wheat or sand.

example.english: There is still one grain of rice at the bottom of the bowl.
example.jyutping: wun2 dai2 zung6 jau5 jat1 nap1 mai5

rows.note: Use this specifically for the visible linear pattern or direction in wood.

example.english: The wood grain of this table is beautiful.
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 muk6 ci4 ge3 muk6 man4 hou2 leng3
